title: Etaleness of the punctured root cover
statement: For a commutative ring R, g in R and positive n invertible in R, put A=R[T]/(T^n-g), q:Spec A to Spec R and V=D(algebraMap R A g), using def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions. The composite V to Spec A to Spec R is etale.

source.place: Tag 0EYG, off-divisor branch; standard basic-open localization and monic root algebra calculation

proof.text: Choose the unit u representing n. For f=X^n-C(g) the explicit identity f'*(C(u^-1)*X)+f*(-1)=C(g) proves that (f,C(g)) is a standard etale pair. Monicity follows from n>0. This identity is proved by linear_combination in Lean, including n=1 and g=0.

StandardEtalePair.equivAwayAdjoinRoot identifies its standard etale ring with S=Localization.Away (algebraMap R A g) as an R-algebra. Transfer Algebra.Etale through this equivalence and then to Spec via HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff.

basicOpenIsoSpecAway identifies V with Spec S. Its compatibility identity and the scalar-tower algebra-map formula identify the composite to Spec R. Isomorphisms and composition preserve etaleness, proving the claim.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EYG motivates the off-divisor application; the explicit algebraic and scheme argument is written here and completely checked by Lean.
